title: Shape it Up! Restoring LLM Safety during Finetuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical framework called Dynamic Safety Shaping (DSS) to prevent Large Language Models from generating harmful content (such as code for cyberattacks) after finetuning. While it mentions 'ethical guidelines' in the context of model refusals, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical frameworks as a core subject of study.
